correctness.rationale: The diagonal substitution q=RS*s produces the quadratic logistic map q→(1+R)q−q² with distinct positive primitive two-cycle q±=(R+2±sqrt(R²−4))/2 precisely for R>2. Its two Jacobians are affine in a single circulant C and commute. Independently expanded their product for general symbolic R,alpha,beta to I−(R+2)(R−1)C/S+(R+2)(C/S)^2 and checked exact rational multipliers at R=12/5 and c=1/100,1/10,1/2. C/S eigenvalues 1 and w±=[1−(alpha+beta)/2 ±i sqrt3(alpha−beta)/2]/S supply full spectrum; longitudinal multiplier is 5−R². On c∈(0,1), w=(1−c)/(1+2c) decreases from1 to0, and P_R(w)−1=(R+2)w(w−(R−1))<0. P_R quadratic minimum passes −1 exactly when (R+2)(R−1)^2=8, equivalently R^3−3R−6=0; the two roots v± and decreasing inverse w→c prove the ordered sink/saddle/sink intervals. R>=sqrt6 fails the longitudinal strict contraction; c>=1 has transverse P_R>=1; c=1 and root couplings are nonhyperbolic rather than assigned a flip bifurcation type. These are local full-3D Floquet statements; finite witnesses alone never establish global parameter inequalities.

final_claim: For R>2 and 1+alpha+beta>0 the positive synchronous primitive two-cycle of the cyclic three-species Euler Lotka–Volterra map has exact three-dimensional Floquet multipliers 5−R^2 and P_R(w_plus/minus). On alpha=beta=c>0, for R between the unique >2 root of R^3−3R−6 and sqrt(6), the same cycle is sink, then two-transverse-direction saddle, then sink as 0<c<1 increases through exact algebraic thresholds.
limitations: Only positive synchronous primitive 2-cycle and its local full three-dimensional linear stability; arbitrary alpha!=beta spectral formula but no complete asymmetric parameter-plane classification; no nonlinear bifurcation criticality or global basin.
